dataList.content:
That's enough, Heathcliff!
住手吧！希斯克利夫！
dataList.place:
Catherine's Room
凯瑟琳的房间

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
Gaah... Cough...
咳……咳……

We can't kill her. Otherwise we won’t know what they were looking for, or why.
必须要留她一条活口。那样我们才能知道她为什么在找东西，在找的东西又是什么。

... Speak.
……说。

I am going to take your utensils and cut off your fingers one by one with each dodgy answer you give me.
如果你不肯说实话的话，我就用你的餐刀把你的手指一根一根地剁下来。

You must know how sharp your own blades are.
自己的餐刀到底有多锋利，你心里应该有数吧。

... Please cooperate, won't you? I don't want to have to use the sleepy smack on my own subordinates.
……能告诉我们吗？我不想亲手对自己的下属动粗……

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
The... diary.
……日记本。

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
Master Linton told us that we must find the diary in Mistress Catherine's room.
林顿家主有令，必须找到在凯瑟琳小姐房间里的……日记本。

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
That she must have hidden her diary somewhere in here as they were making modifications to the manor...
在宅邸改造时……凯瑟琳大人把日记本藏在了某个地方……

I see. So why do you think Master Linton's looking for that diary?
是吗，那林顿少爷为什么要找那个日记本？

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
Master Linton told us that it was to find... a way.
方法……林顿大人说要找到那个。

Please, do keep up your mysterious attitude. A few more answers like that and I will personally demonstrate how I managed to become the Chief Butler.
你们打算一直讲谜语吗？要让我亲自演示我是怎么坐上首席管家的位置的吗？

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
It's the truth. He did not let us in on what this... 'way' is. I have told you all that I know.
我说的都是真的。具体是跟什么有关的方法……大人没有告诉我们。我只知道这些了。

That's it. Looks like I'll have to—
如果你只说不知道的话……

That's enough, Heathcliff. I believe that she is telling the truth. All of you, leave us. Now.
算了，希斯克利夫。她说不知道应该是真心的。你们，退下吧。

And please, do stay out of my sight.
别让我再看见你们。拜托了……

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
Chief Butler Nelly...
耐莉大人……

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
According to what intelligence we could gather...
根据我们的内部情报……

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
The 'Dead Rabbits', the Syndicate of an Urban Plague classification, had long been obliterated from the T Corp. Backstreets.
都市恶疾级别的帮派死兔帮，很久以前就已经在T公司的后巷里被捣毁了。

… What?
……啊？

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
They have been inactive for a long, long time—in other words, they have already been vanquished. Other gangs have not seen the Dead Rabbits in the Backstreets in a while, either.
很久都没有他们活动的迹象……也就是说他们是所谓的被讨伐的帮派。其他黑帮也很久没在后巷见到过死兔帮了。

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
We have no way of verifying their identities. Please, do be careful.
他们是一群身份不明的人。请您务必小心。

Who in the blazes did Mister Hindley let into this manor...? And that diary...
亨德利先生到底把谁引进了这座宅邸……还有日记本到底是……

<A diary, huh... I'm not sure what to expect from it, but...>
<日记本吗……虽然不知道上面写了什么……>

If we do find it, it'll at least clue us in as to what kind of situation we've just walked into.
只要找到的话……就会成为能突破现状的线索吧。

A small container, a space to hide such a thing as a diary... would be these bookshelves or drawers.
要说日记本……之类的小东西可以被藏在哪儿的话，大概是这个书架和抽屉……

But it appears that the Butlers have combed this room clean already.
但是看来他们已经竭尽全力去找了。

Hm hm...! I have once beheld such a sight.
嗯嗯……！吾曾见过类似之物。

Forsooth, 'tis oft the case that a hidden button exists somewhere! We ought to scour this room from corner to corner with magnifying glasses much larger than even Gregor's...!
一般在某个地方有隐藏的按钮！只要用上比格里高尔的那个更大的放大镜，去仔细观察这类地方的话……！

These are glasses for my myopia...
这是近视眼镜……

There are a thousand feathers of so many birds in this pillow.
这枕头里装满了各种鸟的羽毛。应该有上千根吧。

Other people of means like to collect rare bird feathers and stuff their pillows with them. But... I don't like that.
其他富人似乎会收集稀有的羽毛来填充枕头，但是……我不喜欢这样做。

Do you know... why?
这是为什么……你知道吗？

Because birds are meant to fly. Not to be killed like that.
拥有翱翔天空能力的鸟儿……不应被如此杀害。

Yes. Birds do not belong in their cages; they are beings born to soar the skies.
没错。鸟儿是为脱离笼子在天空飞翔而生的存在。

So I am going to empty this pillow of their feathers.
所以我要把这些羽毛全部拿出来。

Instead, I will fill it with my secret.
作为替代，我会用我的秘密将空出来的地方填满。

So that I will always have it at an arm's reach.
为了随时可以从我的枕边将它们寻回。

Heathcliff...? Why are you tearing that pillow open...?
……希斯克利夫先生？为什么突然拿枕头……

This is where... Cathy would have...!
是凯茜的话……肯定……！

... A diary. Hidden within the pillow.
……日记本找到了啊。从枕头里。

Hm... it's stained by ink. Even the cover, too.
唔……有一大块墨渍呢。都渗到封面上了。

I wonder why anyone would do this to their own diary...?
为什么会沾上这些墨渍呢……

Mm... when I would hold my pen against the paper for a long, long time, because I'm not sure what to write...
嗯……如果很长时间不知道从何下笔，所以拿着笔一直按在纸上的话……

... the ink will start to pool and spread, leaving big stains like these.
墨水在纸面上蔓延开来~就会留下这么大一片的墨渍呢。

These ink stains appear to have been made from nonstandard, special ink. A pool of ink that stained this page has left no marks on the subsequent page.
看起来跟一般墨水的质地不一样。在一页上晕染开的墨水在另一页上完全没造成任何影响……

Perhaps...
最重要的是。

... these stains were made on purpose to hide the words under them.
也许是故意利用了遮挡文字的装置。

If that Linton guy's trying so hard to find this diary, then...
如果叫林顿的家伙费尽心力寻找的就是这个日记本的话……

... I'm willing to bet that it's something important.
那这上面一定记载了重要的信息吧。

Most of these pages are stained.
……大部分的页面上都沾有污渍。

True. Most of the pages were stained, and their contents were rather difficult to read.
正如希斯克利夫所说，几乎没有几页是完全可读的。

... I would have liked to read them. Even a little bit.
……我想读。哪怕只有一点点。

That's when...
正当此刻。

... the pages suddenly began to flip rapidly, until it came to a stop at a page with actually legible words.
日记本的纸张突然快速翻动起来，停在了能看到文字的页面上。

It couldn't have been the wind. There weren't any open windows.
不可能是有风吹过，因为窗户都牢牢地关着……

XX/XX
X月X日

Heathcliff left me. Without a word.
希斯克利夫未留一语便离开了我。

A terrible thunderstorm rages outside.
外面电闪雷鸣，风雨交加。

Will he cease to pain my heart and return home once the rain passes? Like Nelly said?
真如耐莉所说，倾盆大雨停下之后，他就不再会让我继续心痛，重新回到家中吗？

XX/XX
X月X日

Fine. Don't come back.
很好，干脆别回来了。

I don't want to see your face ever again, either.
我也不想再见到你了。

XX/XX
X月X日

This manor and me... we're all you have. You don't have anything else.
对你来说你拥有的就只有这座宅邸和我了。

Will you truly abandon what is everything to you?
还是说你要把你拥有的全部都舍弃掉？

Boy, this all feels extremely private. Should we...?
喂，这是我们可以继续看下去的内容吗？

Why don't we leave Heathcliff alone so he can...
让希斯克利夫先生一个人读会比较好……

... No. This entry seems... off.
……不。好像有些奇怪的东西。

XX/XX
X月X日

A guest paid me a visit. The first in a long time.
宅邸久违地迎来了一位客人。

Conversing with someone new... really cleared my head.
跟来人聊天之后，我的头脑变得清醒起来。

And I saw my shape in the mirror before me.
然后我突然看到了映在眼前镜子里的自己。

I know what to do now.
我现在才知道自己该做什么。

The basement.
地下室。

We... must descend there.
我们……得下去那个地方。

Who do you think this 'we' is?
“我们”？到底……是指谁呢。

The basement... the basement...?
地下室……地下室……

From what I remember, Nelly...
耐莉……确实和我的记忆一致……

I agree, Heathcliff.
的确是这样，希斯克利夫。

Everyone, it appears that our next destination lies at the basement of this manor.
各位，我想接下来我们必须前往地下室。

What makes you say that?
你是如何得出这个结论的呢？

The old Mistress, who passed many years ago, ordered us to seal the entrance to the basement.
这座宅邸，很久以前曾因已逝的夫人的命令将地下室封锁了。

Which means that the basement was unsealed when the modifications were made to the manor.
也就是说，那里是因为宅邸改造而解封的空间。

But why... why the basement...?
为什么……去地下室……

Cathy hated the dark. Enough to keep her room always lit with several lanterns.
凯茜不喜欢黑的地方。甚至到了总是想在房间里点上好几盏提灯的程度。

Indeed. I recall having to purchase an entire set of lanterns whenever I left the manor to procure the groceries.
多亏如此，每天去购物的时候都要买上一大堆提灯。

That is certainly suspicious.
确实很可疑啊。

Got any idea as to where we might find the basement, Nelly?
地下室的位置，您对此有头绪吗？耐莉小姐？

Well~ It's usually by the kitchen, isn't it? Let us investigate that place first, shall we?
哎~每家每户的构造都有不同，不过一般都挨着厨房。让我们先从厨房开始找吧。
